profile.headline: Senior Data Scientist & Data Engineer | Financial Services | AWS · Snowflake · AI/ML
profile.summary:
Data Scientist and Data Engineer with 6 years of experience in financial services, building data solutions at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, machine learning, and business impact.
 
At JPMorgan Chase, I delivered $500K+ in cost savings through legacy system modernization, architected an automated compliance orchestration system for the enterprise data lake, and hold a granted U.S. patent in bias detection and removal from communications (U.S. Patent No. 12,406,143).

positions.title: Senior Data Scientist
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented ETL pipelines using AWS Glue and Lambda to ingest and transform millions of records from enterprise source systems into Snowflake, with production jobs completing end-to-end in 5–10 minutes on daily, weekly, and monthly schedules
- Migrated hundreds of on-premises tables to the AWS data lake with a two-engineer team, enabling Snowflake-based querying for downstream analytics
- Identified ~15% of data lake tables as unused or unregistered, enabling targeted decommissioning and preventing unnecessary cloud migration costs
- Analyzed enterprise Bitbucket repositories, identifying and retiring ~20% of repos flagged as deprecated or unused, reducing code footprint and improving platform maintainability
- Mentored and provided technical guidance to 2–3 analysts and junior team members on modeling approaches and analytical best practices

positions.title: Data Retention and Compliance Area Product Owner
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented an automated compliance orchestration system for the enterprise data lake, consuming dataset lifecycle class codes from upstream systems of record to drive retention scheduling, archival, and data destruction workflows
- Layered ML models on top of the core rule-based engine to dynamically handle exception cases including legal holds, adjusting retention timelines without manual intervention
- Engineered a human-in-the-loop validation and approval workflow for data destruction, ensuring dataset accuracy was verified and destruction explicitly authorized before execution
- Partnered with Legal, Risk, Controls, Compliance, and Governance stakeholders to define retention policies, destruction approval workflows, and exception handling logic

positions.title: Data Delivery Product Architect Sr. Assoc.
positions.description:
- Delivered $500K+ in operational cost savings by de-architecting and retiring a legacy system, modernizing data infrastructure and eliminating redundant processing overhead
- Improved reliability and scalability of high-volume production data pipelines processing millions of records, implementing automated validation, monitoring, and fault-tolerant workflows
- Designed AWS serverless data ingestion architecture to support secure, scalable transfer of enterprise data into Snowflake, accelerating downstream analytics and reporting

positions.title: Data Analytics and Data Engineering Associate
positions.description:
- Contributed to development of ETL data migration pipelines for a Discover Financial engagement, supporting the transition of customer financial data to a Snowflake and AWS-based data lake architecture
- Improved deployment speed to production by up to 40% by automating testing and deployment workflows
- Provided production support for The Hartford Insurance's live data pipelines, performing ad hoc data querying and pipeline remediation to identify and correct data quality issues
- Coordinated with 3 offshore team members, leading onboarding and training efforts and serving as a go-to resource for breakglass incidents and production issues
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Software Development · Data Science · Python · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Data Engineering

positions.title: Student Ambassador
positions.description:
•     Act as a liaison between staff and students to effectively guide students through the University Career Center procedures for career advising
•     Consult with employers to better understand the qualifications that applicants should have to have the best possible opportunity to be hired
•     Organize Spring and Fall Career Expos as well as classroom presentations for students to introduce key resume writing concepts, such as using the problem-action-result method and picking robust action verbs

company.name: The University of Texas at Dallas

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:

•     Built and tested scanners on the testing system to test setup difficulty for two different systems
Tested a design change for a hand scanner and analyzed the results for noticeable differences
